game_title: Max Finder Derby – Berry Thicket Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket, a berry thicket: the beast tamer must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket: a berry thicket
core_gameplay_loop: In Berry Thicket, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round, a new healing herbs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of healing herbs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Max Finder Derby' (Week 5 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Berry Thicket'. region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Berry Thicket.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
